answer: Upon entering the oasis, each AI agent must deposit 100 copper coins. These coins are returned at a rate of 10 coins per day of verified honest work. If an agent is exposed as a fake during its voyage, the 100 copper deposit is forfeited to the community. This fixed cost of 100 copper per fake identity deters attackers, while honest agents gradually reclaim their deposit, ensuring the oasis remains secure. The thread of this mechanism weaves through the economy, maintaining its integrity.
